summary: Make active Xingcheng provisions contract-name based rather than pinning schema version suffixes; current versions resolve through their authoritative registries.

changes.proposed:
Xingcheng does not need to own many tool capabilities - tools are provided by governed tools and executors - but it must know how to call tools: emit valid star-tool-call calls with correct parameters, interpret tool results and handle errors and denials; every call routes through the information channel and permission checks, and tool results remain unverified inputs until validated.
Xingcheng never authorises or executes tools itself; tool-calling competence is part of maturity L6 and the Phase 6 acceptance.
star-tool-call (ToolContracts.cs, governed C# lane) is the single current tool-call envelope; its current schema resolves through the authoritative contract registry. The L6 acceptance matrix and governed tool routing are still pending (Phase 6 / G3).

Complete pretraining data pipeline with eleven mandatory elements: Corpus Registry, Dataset Version, Language Classification, Source Tracking, License Validation, Unicode Normalization (with original-to-normalized mapping), Document Deduplication, Sequence Packing, Training/Validation Split, Token Count, Dataset Integrity. Language direction: Traditional Chinese primary, then English, programming languages, mathematics, science, general knowledge and reading comprehension.
Training data must be traceable, verifiable and reproducible. Confidential codex content (including the five zh-TW mirror parts and the codex database), permission data, Xingcheng private auxiliary channels, runtime state / audit journals and unauthorized data must never be added to a training set automatically (fail-closed); license validation precedes ingestion. Normalization must preserve the original-to-normalized mapping and must not damage code, paths, proper nouns or semantics.
The governed corpus pipeline is the native lane xcm_corpus.h (star-pretrain-corpus) inside xc_modeltool with the star-corpus-registry source registry at runtime/settings/corpus-registry.json and the incremental star-corpus-scan-state contract verified by IncrementalCorpusContract; current schemas resolve through their authoritative registries. It lands all eleven mandated elements and enforces the exclusion rule fail-closed by path fragment and registry gate before any read.

Xingcheng may autonomously train and upgrade itself; no user switch exists for self-learning or self-upgrade.
verified examples (quality-gated) -> star-transformer-sft snapshot -> governed SFT/DPO job (MoE-capable) -> evaluation suites -> lifecycle register/stage/activate (auto_activate only when every gate passes) -> retention policy. The current snapshot schema resolves through the authoritative contract registry.
Autonomous-upgrade evidence counts toward maturity level L7 (controlled evolution).
